{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Filter completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders within completed orders
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("QA orders in completed orders:", len(qa_in_completed))

# Remove QA orders from completed orders
clean_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
clean_completed['revenue_numeric'] = clean_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue on clean data
mean_revenue = clean_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print("Mean revenue (after QA removal):", mean_revenue)

# Output number of completed orders after removal
n_completed_clean = len(clean_completed)
print("Number of completed orders after QA removal:", n_completed_clean)"}
